idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Importing a rebar project now adds the dependencies listed under profiles in rebar.config (#1473)
  • Documentation hover and Highlight Usages titles of built-in functions read as name/arity, such as abs/1 (#1476)
  • Uses of ?FEATURE_ENABLED and ?FEATURE_AVAILABLE are no longer reported as unresolved macros (#1468)
  • Pressing Enter over a selected comment no longer shows an error or adds a stray comment prefix (#1464)
  • Enter after a comma in -export([...]), -export_type([...]) and lists aligns the new element with the first one when "Align multiline… (#1186)
  • Completion no longer logs an error when another module has unsaved changes (#1465)
  • Completion after mod: in specs, type definitions and record fields offers the module's exported types (#1191)
  • and 13 more changes: full list
